The wire sample has tCoB = 1.66 nm and tGd = 1.04 nm, selected to preserve the coexistence of skyrmion stability and optical switching.
We nucleate magnetic skyrmions in our wire device, and apply a DC current with density JDC = 5.9 × 109 A m−2 supported by OOP oscillatory field and a temperature T= 350 K (see methods for details).
This system is characterized by some skyrmion pinning, as no visible skyrmion diffusion can be observed at 300 K [17].
The present implementation exhibits limitations due to pinning resulting in different temperature conditions used for optical switching and current-driven motion.
